chatgpt_source: chatgpt.com logged out (incognito, 1280x800 and 390x844, light and dark) plus two logged-in pages the owner saved; values only, no code or assets

rows.chatgpt: only the thread pane (logged in); sidebar and header stay put
rows.ours: only the thread viewport; history panel and header stay put
rows.note: Both keep the side panel fixed. Logged out ChatGPT scrolls the whole document, logged in it scrolls one pane, like ours.

rows.chatgpt: 340 (52 icon rail + 288 list); collapses to a 56 rail
rows.note: ChatGPT never loses the panel: it collapses to an icon rail. Ours hides it. In the demo console the console nav (300) plus history (256) leave the chat 724px at 1280.

rows.chatgpt: margin-inline-start + inline-size 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)
rows.note: Animate the thread sliding over when the panel opens or closes.

rows.chatgpt: 768 (48rem) + 20 padding each side
rows.note: ChatGPT's line is about 76 more px narrow; shorter lines read faster.

no fill; text scrolls under it

rows.note: Logged-in ChatGPT uses plain ghost buttons on a phone; the round floating ones are the logged-out site. Gap 2.
